title: Intro sequence
summary: Hero + subhead + CTA reveal orchestrated by the motion timeline. Demonstrates @hex-core/motion composing existing primitives into a deterministic, agent-authorable sequence.
brief: Build a landing-page hero where the heading fades + slides up first, the subhead follows shortly after, and the primary CTA scales in last. Same input must always render the same final frame.

steps.reason: Bound the hero width and center it
Vertical rhythm between heading, subhead, CTA
Primary call-to-action target of the final clip
Owns the clock and seek; renders nothing itself
Group clips into hero / subhead / CTA windows
One clip per element targeted by CSS selector
Token-aware easing (use `emphasized` for the CTA reveal)

checklist.check: Each animated element has a stable `id` (or unique selector) that the matching <Clip target> references.
Every <Clip> declares `from` AND `to` so the initial paint matches the t=0 state (no flicker on mount).
Total timeline duration stays under 1500ms so the user reaches the interactive state quickly.
Do NOT pass `MotionConfig reducedMotion="never"` in production — the timeline collapses to final state when the OS setting is reduce.
The CTA clip uses `easing="emphasized"` so it lands with attention, not the standard linear-ish curve.
[Container] Avoid: Wrapping a `Container` in another `Container` and getting an unexpectedly narrow column
[Container] Avoid: Using `padding="none"` and forgetting that children still need their own gutter — the parent contributes nothing
[Container] Avoid: Treating `lg` as the largest size — `xl` (66rem) and `full` are bigger
[Container] A11y: Container is presentational. Wrap in a semantic landmark (`<main>`, `<section>`, `<article>`) when the page structure needs it; Container itself renders a plain `<div>`.
[Stack] Avoid: Setting `gap="md"` then adding `mt-*` / `space-y-*` on individual children — pick one spacing system
[Stack] Avoid: Using `align="center"` and wondering why children expand to full width — that's the `stretch` default for cross-axis
[Stack] Avoid: Nesting Stack inside Stack with the same gap when one Stack with two children would suffice
[Stack] A11y: Stack is presentational. Wrap stacked navigation links in a `<nav>`, stacked form fields in a `<form>`, etc. — Stack does not contribute landmark semantics.
[Button] Avoid: Nesting interactive elements inside asChild button
[Button] Avoid: Using — breaks middle-click, cmd-click, and right-click → 'open in new tab', and skips the browser history entry
[Button] Avoid: Using <Button variant='destructive'> for recoverable actions like 'Reset filters' — reserve destructive for delete/archive/leave; use 'secondary' or 'ghost' for resets
[Button] Avoid: Using <Button size='icon'> without an aria-label — screen readers have nothing to announce; always pair icon-only buttons with aria-label or visible text
[Button] A11y: Automatically handles focus ring, disabled state, and aria attributes. Icon-only buttons MUST have aria-label. Loading state automatically sets disabled.
[Motion Timeline] Avoid: Targeting elements with selectors that don't exist yet — clips silently skip non-matches.
[Motion Timeline] Avoid: Mixing imperative useAnimate calls on the same target — the timeline driver will overwrite them.
[Motion Timeline] A11y: Respects `prefers-reduced-motion`; with reduce active all clips collapse to their `to` state immediately.
[Scene] Avoid: Overlapping scenes that animate the same target with conflicting `to` values — the later animation will cancel the earlier one mid-flight.
[Scene] A11y: Inherits the Timeline's reduced-motion behavior.
[Clip] Avoid: Omitting `from` and expecting an inferred initial — the engine treats undefined as the element's current style, which can flicker.
[Clip] Avoid: Using non-unique selectors that match multiple elements — only the first match is animated.
[Clip] A11y: Inherits the Timeline's reduced-motion behavior.
[Transition] Avoid: Hard-coding ms numbers throughout the codebase instead of named easings — themes can't override them later.
[Transition] Avoid: Setting `duration: 0` to disable a transition; pass `initial={false}` on the host instead.
[Transition] A11y: Always respects MotionConfig's reducedMotion mode at the engine level.
